Want an eye-catching surface design without spending hours nitpicking? Try this: I start with about 0.75lb of clay and throw a 3.5” x 3.5” cylinder with a slight barrel shape. While it’s still on the wheel, I pre-trim a shallow foot, so I don’t have to mess with the texture later. Then comes the magic. Slip applied in an upward and downward spiral motion while the wheel spins. It creates this unpredictable, organic pattern that’s completely unique to each throw. Pro tip: run your slip through a sieve a few times for a buttery smooth consistency. No chunks, no drag, just clean movement. Give it a shot and let me know how it works for you. Val Cushing was a ceramics professor for almost 50 years and a huge figure in the clay community. He created tons of handouts like this one to share his knowledge before the internet was popularized. Some of these ideas are wild- like a gong or a stool?! But I love that there are so many things here that can inspire us all to make more than just mugs. #clay #ceramics #pottery #highschoolart #highschoolceramics #beginner
